newsitem.title: USA: Engle Homes optimistic on new home sales.
newsitem.headline: Engle Homes optimistic on new home sales.

text.p: Engle Homes Inc said Thursday it is optimistic that a trend of increased new home sales contracts can continue into its fiscal year 1998.

The homebuilder's president and chief executive officer, Alec Engelstein, said the company confidence is based on what he said was the current high levels of consumer confidence, low interest rates and his company's continued geographic expansion into new markets.

He made the statement as the company reported that for its fiscal third quarter of 1997 ended July 31, its net income rose 46 percent to $3.6 million or $0.52 per share ($0.43 fully diluted) compared with $2.5 million or $0.35 per share ($0.30 fully diluted) in the quarter a year ago.
Revenues for the latest quarter rose 18 percent to $107.1 million compared with $90.4 million a year ago, it said.
